params.1273: Build a room in your house (such as a parlour).
params.1274: Buy a house (see the Task 'Unreal Estate, Man').
params.1276: Visit your house in Building Mode using the house portal it is attached to (if your house is in Burthorpe, follow this hint arrow).
params.1277: Use any door hotspot and choose to build a parlour.
params.1278: Rotate it to your satisfaction and confirm your purchase to build the room.
params.2225: You can personalise a room you have built with furniture and fixtures.
